content: 1. Lamotrigine levels may be reduced due to the induction of lamotrigine glucuronidation by certain drugs. This interaction can lead to decreased therapeutic efficacy of lamotrigine. Close monitoring is advised. 2. Lenacapavir can increase the levels or effects of norethindrone by inhibiting the hepatic and intestinal enzyme CYP3A4 metabolism. Caution and monitoring are recommended. 3. Lenacapavir may enhance the effects of CYP3A4 substrates initiated within nine months after the last subcutaneous dose, potentially increasing the risk of adverse reactions. Monitoring is necessary. 4. Letermovir increases norethindrone levels by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Caution and monitoring are advised. 5. Lopinavir increases norethindrone levels or effects by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Caution and monitoring are recommended. 6. Norethindrone increases maraviroc levels by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism, which may lead to increased toxicity. Caution and monitoring are advised. 7. Norethindrone reduces the effects of metformin through pharmacodynamic antagonism. Caution and monitoring are necessary. 8. Mifepristone reduces the effects of norethindrone via pharmacodynamic antagonism. Backup contraceptive methods are recommended, and caution should be exercised. 9. Nafcillin decreases norethindrone levels or effects by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Nonhormonal contraceptives are advised during therapy, and monitoring is required. 10. Nelfinavir increases norethindrone levels or effects by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Caution and monitoring are recommended. 11. Nemolizumab decreases norethindrone levels by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Therapy modification and close monitoring are necessary. Nemolizumab suppresses cytokines, potentially increasing CYP enzyme activity, which may reduce systemic levels of narrow therapeutic index drugs. Dosage adjustments may be required. 12. Ritonavir increases norethindrone levels or effects by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Caution and monitoring are advised. 13. Rucaparib increases norethindrone levels or effects by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Therapy modification and close monitoring are necessary. Dosage adjustments of CYP3A4 substrates may be clinically indicated. 14. Rufinamide reduces norethindrone effects by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Caution and monitoring are recommended. Rufinamide is a weak CYP3A4 inducer and can decrease the exposure of drugs metabolized by CYP3A4. 15. Siltuximab may restore CYP450 enzymatic activity by inhibiting IL-6, which is downregulated during infection and inflammation. Caution is advised when coadministering with CYP substrates that have a narrow therapeutic index. 16. Stiripentol affects norethindrone metabolism by inhibiting and inducing CYP3A4. Therapy modification and close monitoring are necessary. Dosage adjustments of CYP3A4 substrates may be required. 17. Tazemetostat decreases norethindrone levels or effects by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Caution and monitoring are advised. 18. Tecovirimat decreases norethindrone levels or effects by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Caution and monitoring are recommended. Tecovirimat is a weak CYP3A4 inducer, and sensitive CYP3A4 substrates should be monitored for effectiveness. 19. Tesamorelin decreases norethindrone levels or effects by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Alternative contraception is recommended, and caution should be exercised. 20. Voriconazole increases norethindrone levels or effects by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Caution and monitoring are advised. 21. Acetazolamide increases norethindrone levels or effects by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. The clinical significance is unknown. 22. Anastrozole increases norethindrone levels or effects by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. The clinical significance is unknown. 23. Cyclophosphamide increases norethindrone levels or effects by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. The clinical significance is unknown. 24. Danazol increases norethindrone levels or effects by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. The clinical significance is unknown. 25. Drospirenone increases norethindrone levels or effects by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. The clinical significance is unknown. 26. Larotrectinib increases norethindrone levels or effects by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. The clinical significance is unknown. 27. Levoketoconazole increases norethindrone levels or effects by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. The clinical significance is unknown. 28. Ribociclib increases norethindrone levels or effects by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. The clinical significance is unknown. 29. Acitretin reduces norethindrone effects through an unknown mechanism. Contraceptive failure may result, and alternative methods are recommended. 30. Amobarbital decreases norethindrone levels or effects by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Caution and monitoring are necessary. 31. Apalutamide decreases norethindrone levels or effects by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid coadministration unless benefits outweigh risks. Hormonal contraceptives are unreliable during coadministration. 32. Atazanavir may increase or decrease norethindrone levels by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Therapy modification and close monitoring are necessary. 33. Belzutifan decreases norethindrone levels or effects by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Hormonal contraceptive failure may occur. Nonhormonal contraception is advised. 34. Bosentan decreases norethindrone levels or effects by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid or use alternative drugs. 35. Brigatinib decreases norethindrone levels or effects by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Hormonal contraceptives are unreliable during coadministration. Nonhormonal contraception is recommended. 36. Carbamazepine decreases norethindrone levels or effects by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid coadministration unless benefits outweigh risks. 37. Cenobamate decreases norethindrone levels or effects by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Therapy modification and close monitoring are necessary. 38. Clobazam decreases norethindrone levels or effects by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Nonhormonal contraception is recommended. 39. Colesevelam decreases norethindrone levels by drug binding in the gastrointestinal tract. Administer oral contraceptives at least four hours before colesevelam. 40. Crofelemer increases norethindrone levels by inhibiting CYP3A4 in the gut. Systemic inhibition is unlikely due to minimal absorption. 41. Dabrafenib decreases norethindrone levels or effects by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Therapy modification and close monitoring are necessary. 42. Efavirenz decreases norethindrone levels or effects by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid or use alternative drugs. 43. Elagolix decreases norethindrone levels or effects by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Therapy modification and close monitoring are necessary. 44. Encorafenib affects norethindrone metabolism by both inhibiting and inducing CYP3A4. Therapy modification and close monitoring are necessary. 45. Enzalutamide decreases norethindrone levels or effects by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Hormonal contraceptives are unreliable during coadministration. 46. Etravirine decreases norethindrone levels or effects by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Caution and monitoring are necessary. 47. Fedratinib increases norethindrone levels or effects by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Therapy modification and close monitoring are necessary. 48. Fexinidazole increases norethindrone levels or effects by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid or use alternative drugs. 49. Fosamprenavir has an unspecified interaction mechanism with norethindrone. Nonhormonal contraception is recommended. 50. Fosphenytoin decreases norethindrone levels or effects by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid or use alternative drugs. 51. Idelalisib increases norethindrone levels or effects by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid or use alternative drugs. 52. Iloperidone increases norethindrone levels by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Therapy modification and close monitoring are necessary. 53. Indinavir increases norethindrone levels or effects by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Caution and monitoring are advised. 54. Norethindrone decreases lamotrigine levels by increasing hepatic clearance. Combination oral contraceptives significantly reduce lamotrigine plasma concentrations.
